thread:
leah_cs: Heads-up: Surfboard AI wants a short APAC demo window tomorrow 09:30 SGT. Staging hit throttle. Asking for 36h throughput bump + CIDR allowlist. Renewal review in 10 days, so this demo is high-impact.

mike_infra: Please drop CIDRs and exact window. Region prefer? Need model slug to pin capacity.

leah_cs: Owner is rachel@surfboard.ai. Window: 2026-04-02T01:00Z -> 2026-04-03T13:00Z (36h). Peak qps ~1600, steady ~700. CIDRs: 18.204.32.0/24 and 3.120.0.0/16. Prefer asia-southeast-1. Model: surf-demo-v2 -> redwood/gpt-medium-v2-staging. They also asked for short prefix caching.

ops-bot: Ticket OPS-6342 created by @mike_infra: "Surfboard APAC demo temporary burst + CIDR allowlist". Approval SLA 2h. https://redwood.ops/OPS-6342

mike_infra: I'll reserve a small burst pool and add CIDRs to proxy allowlist. Jules, can you pre-warm KV cache and set concurrency bump? Also set batch_max_tokens=320 for demo parity.

jules_se: On it. Pre-warming top-8 prompts, concurrency=16, batch_max_tokens=320, prefix_cache TTL=300s. I'll spin a canary route and run a quick smoke.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment queued: canary/redwood-gpt-medium-v2-warmed -> asia-southeast-1. ETA ~12m.

mike_infra: Note: limiting burst to the demo model only and locking to CIDRs. Will add auto-revoke.

leah_cs: cc @frank_ae please note any cost uplift for renewal convo.

frank_ae: Aware. If demo goes well, we'll surface as momentum. If they ask to extend, I'll prepare amendment language.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed successfully. Warm logs: "kv_cache_hits=92%".

mike_infra: Updated OPS-6342: 36h burst provisioned, CIDRs added, region pinned, concurrency increased. Estimated uplift ~$620. Auto-revoke set at 2026-04-03T13:05Z.

leah_cs: Confirmed with customer: smoke passed at 09:10 SGT, main demo at 09:30 ran clean. Sara sent short clip. AE will record in renewal notes.

mike_infra: OPS-6342 closed as complete. Revoke will be automatic; reach out if they request extension.

leah_cs: Thanks team. Marking as positive signal for renewal. :white_check_mark:
